prompt: What is the sum of all three-letter Roman numerals that read the same forwards and backwards?
answer:
Using standard (canonical) Roman numeral notation, the three-letter palindromes are:

\[
\text{III}=3,\quad \text{XIX}=19,\quad \text{XXX}=30,\quad \text{CXC}=190,
\]
\[
\text{CCC}=300,\quad \text{MCM}=1900,\quad \text{MMM}=3000.
\]

Their sum is

\[
3+19+30+190+300+1900+3000=\boxed{5442}.
\]
